claims.text: The resort sits on a peninsula surrounded by Savusavu Bay.

findings.quote: Nestled on a peninsula surrounded by Savusavu Bay

claims.text: The resort is on Vanua Levu, Fiji's northern island, near the town of Savusavu.

findings.quote: The Jean-Michel Cousteau Resort is located on the northern Fijian island of Vanua Levu, with Savusavu, the closest larger town to the resort

claims.text: The resort is set on 17 acres overlooking Savusavu Bay, less than a 15-minute drive from downtown Savusavu.

findings.quote: Set on 17 acres overlooking Savusavu Bay, the resort is less than a 15-minute drive from downtown Savusavu.

claims.text: Jean-Michel Cousteau, son of ocean explorer Jacques Cousteau, discovered the property in the 1980s and gave the resort his name.

findings.quote: Jean-Michel Cousteau, son of renowned ocean explorer Jacques Cousteau, discovered the property in the 1980s, found an investor, and gave the resort his name.

claims.text: The resort's design is inspired by a traditional Fijian village.

findings.quote: The overall resort design is inspired by a traditional Fijian village.

claims.text: The bures have vaulted, exposed-beam ceilings with woven magimagi, a coconut fiber rope.

findings.quote: Vaulted, exposed beam ceilings feature woven magimagi (coconut fiber rope)

claims.text: The bures have no phones or televisions, but there is Wi-Fi.

findings.quote: None of the bures have phones or televisions, but there is Wi-Fi.

claims.text: The Dreamhouse dive site has barracudas, grey reef sharks and white tip sharks and is recommended for seasoned divers.

findings.quote: Dreamhouse lures with barracudas, grey reef sharks, and white tip sharks. Recommended for seasoned divers.

claims.text: The Golden Nugget site is a calm, shallow protected area suited to snorkelers.

findings.quote: explore a serene protected area ideal for snorkelers. Discover colourful reef fish and diverse marine species in calm, shallow waters.

claims.text: The spa offers traditional Fijian Bobo massage.

findings.quote: provides a memorable introduction to the art of traditional Fijian Bobo massage

claims.text: A teen program offers reef conservation, cultural storytelling and waterfall hikes.

findings.quote: The Teen Program engages teenagers in adventures like reef conservation, cultural storytelling and waterfall hikes.

claims.text: A traditional Fijian lovo feast is prepared once a week.

findings.quote: A traditional Fijian Lovo feast is prepared once a week

claims.text: Divers can visit the Namena Marine Reserve, known for coral biodiversity, large fish populations, hawksbill turtles and seasonal whale migrations.

findings.quote: the Namena Marine Reserve beckons underwater adventurers with its vibrant marine life. Encounter exceptional coral biodiversity, large fish populations, hawksbill turtles, and seasonal whale migrations.

claims.text: Resident marine biologists lead snorkeling expeditions and presentations on Savusavu Bay's marine ecology.

findings.quote: Meet our resident Marine Biologists, dedicated to marine education and conservation.
bring Savusavu Bay’s vibrant marine ecology to life through thrilling snorkeling expeditions and engaging presentations.

claims.text: The Oceanfront Point Reef Spa Tub Bure has a private spa tub on the deck with views of Point Reef Beach.

findings.quote: Step onto the deck to enjoy a private Spa Tub with breathtaking views of Point Reef Beach.

claims.text: The Kids Bula Club is free for all guests.

findings.quote: the Kids Bula Club is free for all our guests

claims.text: The Premium Oceanfront Two-Bedroom Villa has its own pool and spa tub.

findings.quote: 1 bedroom with ensuite bathroom: 1 king bed. 2nd bedroom with ensuite: 2 single day beds. Pool and Spa Tub

claims.text: Getting there takes two flights: international flights arrive at Nadi, then guests take a domestic flight to Savusavu and a 20-minute transfer by road.

findings.quote: International flights to Fiji arrive at Nadi International Airport (NAN).
From Nadi, you take a domestic flight to Savusavu (SVU).
will transfer you to the resort, just a 20-minute drive away.

claims.text: The spa is small: the beachfront spa bure has two oceanfront, open-air treatment rooms.

findings.quote: With only a pair of oceanfront, open-air treatment rooms, the beachfront spa bure is teeny

claims.text: There are no adapted bures, but paths are paved and ramps reach public areas.

findings.quote: There are no adapted bures, but guests can request rooms close to the central area of the resort. Paths throughout the property are paved, and ramps provide access to public areas
